title: The Note under the Bowl
story: Ben left a slice of cake on the kitchen table before football. He covered it with a plate and planned to eat it later. When he returned, the plate was empty and clean. He asked the people at home, and each one said they had not taken it. Ben felt cross and looked for crumbs. There were no crumbs on the table or the floor. Then he lifted the fruit bowl and found a folded note underneath. The note was from his little sister, Aya. She had taken the slice to school to share with a new student. She had washed the plate and hidden the note so it would be a surprise. Ben read it twice and stopped feeling cross. He left a reply under the same bowl. In the reply he thanked Aya and said the next slice would be hers. The mystery had a kind ending.
